reviews.body:
Reviewed the release candidate at exact head `0653290139ff7ad1484e9c9e21c2e5787f1021aa` against `main` `bee0d122bf23410e3d2db69649ad5e44959b6cd8`, after merging the ancestry-only #144 update. Compare confirms #144 added 0 files to staging and the tested merge tree matches the current head.

Fresh release CI [46045501294](https://github.com/Punge089/classpulse/actions/runs/46045501294) passed on this exact head: server 272, client 23, browser 12 (307 total), with 0 failures/skips; migration, both builds and Docker passed. The previously reviewed feature changes have their own exact-head approvals and CI.

Please correct two stale Lab 7 status statements in the release tree before main approval:
1. `docs/labs/lab-07/assignment-changes.md` says “B's agreement is pending,” but B's C3 on Issue #87 (comment 7159676041) reviewed the contract and explicitly allowed test-only RED work.
2. `docs/labs/lab-07/execution-plan.md` says PR #95 still needs B review/CI on the current commit, but B approved exact head `dea22a2` and merged it to staging as `bed5880` (#95).

These are factual status mismatches in the release documentation. I am not approving or merging #143 yet; after the corrections, please update staging and request a fresh release CI/review.

reviews.body: Approved the current release candidate at exact head 2f99a06b531c95b9b0a86b2b082f53d4974ee046 against main bee0d122bf23410e3d2db69649ad5e44959b6cd8. The head is the merge commit for #145, which corrects both previously identified Lab 7 status mismatches: B's C3/test-only RED authorization is recorded, and PR #95's exact approval and staging merge are recorded. The three-file correction is documentation-only and within the release plan's scope. Fresh exact-head CI run 46049699597 passed: server 272, client 23, browser 12 (307 total), 0 failed/skipped; database migrations, server/client builds, and Docker image build passed. PR #143 remains a main-release coordination gate; this review does not merge it. Deployment and post-release GCP evidence remain pending.
